desc:
Goal Line! is a first-person football game where you're the QB and coach! Build your franchise, open player packs, manage your roster, and climb the leagues from Sandlot to LEGENDS. Call plays, read defenses, throw where you look, dodge pass rushers, truck defenders, and score in any weather!

FEATURES
- League Seasons, Playoffs & GOAL LINE BOWL
- Quick Game & Live Versus
- Build Your Roster & Trade Players
- Player Packs & Collection
- Daily/Weekly Challenges & Leaderboards
- Season Pass, Login Rewards & Trophies
- Team Colors & Customization
- Shop, Boosters & Training

BETA: Bugs may occur.

Supports PC, Controller & Mobile.

Tags: Football, NFL, Touchdown, Sports
